tasks.title: Thread Pool
tasks.prompt: Implement a fixed-size thread pool in C++17 for CPU-bound integer tasks. Provide class ThreadPool with constructor ThreadPool(std::size_t), destructor, std::future<int> enqueue(std::function<int()>), and void wait_for_tasks(). Use std::thread, std::mutex, std::condition_variable, and std::future. The destructor must stop workers cleanly. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Parallel Matrix Multiplication with OpenMP
tasks.prompt: Implement std::vector<std::vector<int>> parallel_matrix_multiply(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& a, const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& b) in C++17. Validate dimensions, throw std::invalid_argument for empty or incompatible matrices, and use OpenMP to parallelize the multiplication. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Producer Consumer Queue
tasks.prompt: Implement a bounded producer-consumer queue in C++17 using a mutex and condition variables. Provide class ProducerConsumerQueue with constructor(capacity), push(int), bool pop(int&), and close(). push blocks when full, pop blocks when empty and returns false only after close and drain. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Lock-Free Queue
tasks.prompt: Implement a bounded lock-free queue for integers in C++17. Provide class LockFreeQueue with constructor(capacity), bool enqueue(int), and bool dequeue(int&). Support multiple producers and consumers using atomics and compare-exchange. Do not use mutexes in the hot path. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Parallel Quicksort
tasks.prompt: Implement void parallel_quicksort(std::vector<int>& values) in C++17. Use task parallelism with std::async, std::future, or worker threads and include a sequential fallback for small partitions. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Parallel Prefix Sum
tasks.prompt: Implement std::vector<long long> parallel_prefix_sum(const std::vector<int>& input) in C++17. Return an inclusive prefix sum, use multiple threads to process blocks in parallel, and handle empty input correctly. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: MPI Reduce
tasks.prompt: Implement int mpi_sum_reduce(const std::vector<int>& local_values, MPI_Comm comm) in C++17. Compute the local sum and perform a global reduction across all ranks using MPI collectives. Return the global sum to every rank. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Parallel BFS
tasks.prompt: Implement std::vector<int> parallel_bfs_levels(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& graph, int source) in C++17. Return BFS distances from the source, use -1 for unreachable nodes, and process each frontier in parallel using multiple threads while avoiding duplicate visits. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Work-Stealing Scheduler
tasks.prompt: Implement a simple work-stealing scheduler in C++17. Provide class WorkStealingScheduler with constructor(worker_count), destructor, submit(std::function<void()>), and wait(). Each worker owns a local deque and idle workers steal tasks from the back of other workers' deques. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.

tasks.title: Concurrent Hash Map
tasks.prompt: Implement a concurrent hash map in C++17. Provide class ConcurrentHashMap with constructor(bucket_count), put(int,int), bool get(int,int&) const, increment(int,int), and size() const. Use bucket-level locking with separate mutexes to support concurrent access. Return one self-contained C++17 source file with no main.
